caption: The drawing shows a four-poster bed with prominent red curtains and green columns at the corners. Inside the bed, two figures lie side by side; one figure, largely obscured and dressed in a white garment with red trim, lies under a pink blanket. The other figure is more visible, with blue clothing and their hands folded across the body, holding a green laurel wreath. A large black cross is positioned vertically at the center of the bed, dividing the two figures and extending from the headboard to the foot of the bed. The headboard and footboard of the bed are detailed with red and white vertical stripes and geometric patterns. The bed and figures are framed by the curtains, and the overall composition uses thick black outlines for emphasis. There is the number "14" printed in small blue type in the lower left corner of the image. The background is a plain beige or off-white color.
title: Plate 14: Main Altarpiece, Chimayo: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
